main.description: One reader's map exploration progress for a single wiki: which places they have discovered. The rkey is a TID; the wiki it belongs to lives in the record body. Stored on the reader's own PDS so progress follows the account across devices and appviews. Discovery is additive — clients merge by union rather than overwriting, so a device that was offline cannot erase places found elsewhere.

wikiRef.description: AT-URI of the wiki this progress belongs to.

discovered.description: Slugs of notes whose map location the reader has visited at least once.

updatedAt.description: When this progress record was last written.
